stem: An outbreak's epi curve rises for 8 days, then falls. To find the final size of the outbreak (the total number of cases it produced), you would:

options.A: add up the daily new case counts
options.B: read the height of the peak day
options.C: multiply the peak day count by eight
options.D: check how steep the early rise was
